lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Saturday. The shift is over, but the block isn't. You keep seeing the same street on the back of your eyelids — the blue house, the line that didn't hang up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's the strange part: nobody told you to drop it. The system did — a recommendation, a default, a green button. No hands on it. Everyone's hands on it.

beats.prompt: Alone with the pattern. What do you do?

choices.label: Start a private file — dates, names, everything.
You're imagining patterns. Let it go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You open a notebook the department doesn't know about and write down everything you remember. It feels like paranoia. It feels like the only honest thing you've done all week.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You close the laptop and pour a drink until the street goes quiet in your head. It's still there in the morning. It's always still there.
